name: Apply this flow for the first login of user after creating account successful. ---- User without an account: Access the app → select language → create account (since they don’t have an account, they can’t log in and therefore can’t create a care plan yet). User with an account (first-time login – for FC and FC mode): Log in successfully → onboarding: create care plan (no language selection here, as it was already chosen during the first app access).
